scripts.dev: npm run build:frontend && npm run dev -w @armilla/backend
scripts.dev:all: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names BE,FE --prefix-colors blue,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm run db:generate && npm run build -w @armilla/frontend && npm run build -w @armilla/backend
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @armilla/frontend && npm run lint -w @armilla/backend
